obsNoRecordsBody: 应用发出请求后会在这里留下记录；HTTPS 记录需要开启流量检查。
Requests made by apps are recorded here; HTTPS records need traffic inspection enabled.
obsBypassedDns: 直连，未经过 DNS 解析流程
Direct, bypassing the DNS resolution flow
obsBlockedDns: 被过滤规则拦截，未发出查询
Blocked by a filter rule before any query was sent
obsRewrittenDns: 命中了覆写规则，返回改写后的结果
Matched a rewrite rule and returned the rewritten answer
obsErrorDns: 解析过程出错，未取得应答
The lookup failed and produced no answer
obsPassedDns: 按规则解析并正常返回
Resolved by the rules and answered normally
obsRewrittenHttps: 命中了覆写规则，返回改写后的请求
Matched a rewrite rule and forwarded the rewritten request
obsBlockedHttps: 被过滤规则拦截，未建立连接
Blocked by a filter rule before connecting
obsNoRuleHttps: 未命中规则（或未记录规则）
No rule matched (or none was recorded)
obsRawRecordFooter: 引擎写入 message 字段的原文，未经改写。
The verbatim message field written by the engine.
obsFailedHint: 处理失败的请求可在「连接」页配合查看对应的活动连接。
For failed requests, check the matching active connections on the Connections page.
obsRulesHint: 加入的黑白名单可在「规则」页查看和撤销。
Rules added here can be reviewed and undone on the Rules page.
obsIpOnlyFooter: 该记录只有 IP 地址，域名规则无法匹配，因此不能加入黑白名单。
This record only has an IP address, which domain rules cannot match, so it cannot be added to the lists.
obsAnalyzeRequestBody: 用配置的模型研判归属、风险与处置建议
Use the configured model to judge ownership, risk and next steps
